_readme: Inputs for script/DeployUnichainSepolia.s.sol and script/DeployLasna.s.sol. Every external value has a 'source' (official docs only, read 2026-11-25). 'TODO' = not confirmed from an official source; see docs/DEPLOY.md. Public data only: no keys, no secrets.

deployer.note: Burner wallet (public address only). Must deploy BOTH the Unichain receivers and the Lasna RCs: the receivers accept callbacks only for the RVM id of their deployer (reactive-lib AbstractCallback: rvm_id = msg.sender).

rpc.note: Public, rate-limited, not for production. The only keyless Sepolia RPC in the official docs. Alternatives: providers on https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/unichain/tools/node-providers (no endpoint URLs given; most need an API key).

verification.note: Docs: Etherscan API V2 keys work for Unichain Sepolia via forge --verify --etherscan-api-key. An explicit --verifier-url is not documented: TODO.

rpc.note: No official Unichain/Reactive doc names a Sepolia RPC. Use any Sepolia RPC you trust; scripts take it as --rpc-url.

l1StandardBridgeProxy.note: Send ETH to this address on Sepolia to bridge to Unichain Sepolia (get-funds page). Docs: addresses 'subject to change'.

faucet.note: No official Unichain or Reactive doc recommends a Sepolia ETH faucet.

systemContract.note: Subscriptions, react() calls, billing, depositTo/reserves/debt. reactive-lib-omni (AbstractReactive.SYSTEM) uses it.

cronEmitter.note: Legacy system contract; still EMITS the Cron events, but is no longer the subscription/payment endpoint. RCs built on the legacy reactive-lib (service = this address) are blacklisted on their first event: docs/INCIDENT_REACTIVE.md.

cronTopic.name: Cron1000
cronTopic.note: Every cron event is a billed reactive tx. Measured 2026-11-25: fee = basefee 100 gwei * (gas + _extraGas 100000) = ~0.012-0.016 lREACT per tick; Lasna ~1.085 s/block. Cron100 (~108 s) ~10 lREACT/day; Cron1000 (~18 min) ~1 lREACT/day.

available.note: 2025-02-10: Data Feeds available on Unichain Sepolia.

ethUsd.note: Read from the page's data file https://reference-data-directory.vercel.app/feeds-ethereum-testnet-sepolia-unichain-1.json

demoPool._doc: Pool A: the scripted headline demo (script/demo_testnet.sh). MockReferencePrice is REQUIRED here: the demo's Market moves the fair price.

chainlinkPool._doc: Pool B: live Chainlink fair price (ETH/USD over USDC/USD) for mock tWETH (18 dec) / tUSDC (6 dec). Same curator contract as pool A, so a freeze on A is relayed to B. maxOracleAge must exceed the 86400 s feed heartbeat.

tenure._receiverFundingDoc: ETH deposited into EACH receiver's RESERVES at the Unichain callback proxy with depositTo(address). Never sent to the receiver's own balance.

reactive._doc: lREACT deposited into each RC's RESERVES at the system contract 0x8888 with depositTo(address) (DeployLasna). settlerDelayBlocks is in LASNA blocks: 60 x ~1.085 s = ~65 s > the hook window W = 50 Unichain blocks of 1 s.
